thread:
Lena (People Ops): quick drop: made tiny paste-ready templates for hiring feedback, candidate notes, and self-review lines when you've helped interview. hoping this reduces noise in debriefs :memo:
Marco (Hiring Manager): awesome. can we get a 3-line candidate feedback template? some folks write novels
Lena (People Ops): yup — kept it micro. added a 3-line "score + evidence + decision input" block below
Rina (IC): also can we have a one-line "how i contributed to hiring" snippet for self-reviews? small wins matter
Lena (People Ops): included. plus a manager micro-calibration checklist (for role parity across hiring panels)
Recruiter Bot: reminder  — add interview scorecard links to candidate thread: https://recruiting.redwood/candidates (auto)
Marco (Hiring Manager): can you paste the exact copy i can shove into the debrief slack thread?
Lena (People Ops): pasted below  feel free to copy/paste into panel debriefs and 1:1s

--- paste-ready: candidate feedback (3 lines) ---
- Overall score: 1-5 (reason)
- Evidence: 2 bullets (strengths, concern with example)
- Hiring input: recommend (hire / maybe / pass) + one short rationales

Example: 
- Overall score: 4 (strong backend fundamentals)
- Evidence: solid system design on checkout flow; slower on follow-up debugging question
- Hiring input: recommend hire; pairing mentoring to ramp on infra debugging

--- paste-ready: manager calibration checklist ---
- Panel parity: did we cover the same core skills across candidates? (note gaps)
- Role alignment: is candidate's expected scope aligned to this level or higher/lower?
- Risk signals: top 2 concerns and mitigation plan if hired

--- paste-ready: self-review line when you interviewed (1 line) ---
- Interview contribution: ran 3 interviews (candidate links)  provided hiring feedback focused on system design and mentorship fit

--- lightweight rubric for scoring ---
- 5: standout (clearly exceeds role expectations)
- 4: strong (meets + some stretch)
- 3: solid (meets expectations)
- 2: gaps (misses key expectations)
- 1: not ready (significant gaps)

--- end paste ---

Rina (IC): love the "one-liner" for self-review  makes the PR description tidy
Marco (Hiring Manager): i'll adopt this for the next panel. can we add a note to ask interviewers to paste the top line of evidence (one sentence) — helps calibration syncs
Lena (People Ops): added that as a required micro-step in the debrief template. i'll also put this in the hiring ops playbook and ping the hiring channel when it's live
Recruiter Bot: note  hiring ops checklist updated: candidate feedback template v1.0 (auto-entry)
